answer: University degree attestation keeps fake identities out of the alumni roll. A newcomer shows a degree certificate, and the registrar confirms the name, degree, and graduation year against its public registry. A record tied to another identity is rejected, and members re-confirm each year. One honest graduate spends nothing and ten minutes, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 diploma-mill degrees at $300 each, or $300,000. Voyage certifies the degree, Ledge holds the registry, Dune keeps the alumni honest.
